{{short description|Uniform tiling of the hyperbolic plane}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U74_12}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-7 square tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{4,7}.
